skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the importance and role of healthcare services, financing mechanisms, and service delivery systems.
Grasp the role and classification of health insurance, relationships between insurers and service providers, and payment methods.
Comprehend the concept, characteristics, eligibility criteria, benefit packages, funding sources, and implementation of social health insurance.
Understand the concept, characteristics, eligibility criteria, benefits, factors influencing premiums, funding sources, and management of commercial health insurance.
Analyze global healthcare financing models such as Beveridge and Bismarck systems, payment methods, and insurance programs in various countries.
Examine Vietnamese policies on social health insurance implementation and commercial health insurance management.
